verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for a payroll platform with a developer API program. The evidence shows API Central (OAuth, templates, code samples, 'real-time data sharing'), but nothing documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or subscriptions to events such as payroll processed, employee onboarded or payment failed. API access is a developer building block, not a webhook capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to payroll lifecycle events (payroll processed, employee onboarded, payment failed) via webhooks to drive downstream automations
